chief_complaint: Advanced chronic kidney disease (stage 4) with awaiting kidney transplantation and high cardiovascular disease burden (ischemic heart disease, prior CABG, angina).
history_of_present_illness: The patient has a >40‑year history of type 2 diabetes mellitus and essential hypertension, which have driven progressive diabetic nephropathy documented as CKD stages 1 through 4 from 1992 to 1999. Proteinuria and microalbuminuria appeared in the mid‑1990s, and anemia was noted in 1980. Ischemic heart disease was diagnosed in 1991, leading to coronary artery bypass grafting the same year; intermittent angina persists, treated with nitroglycerin spray. Metabolic syndrome, obesity, and hypertriglyceridemia further increase cardiovascular risk. The patient is awaiting kidney transplantation since 1999. Social factors such as limited social contact, housing instability, stress, and a criminal record are chronic. The most recent documented encounter was in June 2003, and many recent vital signs and laboratory values are missing.

active_problems.name: History of coronary artery bypass grafting
